tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by two different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Elvis Presley's estate is suing Anthropic, reported by Yahoo, over the use of 274 songs in training without permission.
Ohio labor groups are backing a regulation bill, reported by Hoodline, that would require transparency and human oversight in employment and benefits decisions.
Pennsylvania will require labels on artificially generated ads, confirmed by The Verge, though the rules have major loopholes around what counts as significant modification.
Daytona has raised 60 million dollars, reported by WeRSM, to build cloud infrastructure for artificial intelligence agents that need isolated and stateful environments.
OpenAI is now keeping its frontier models offline during training, reported by PCMag UK, to protect them from internet exposure.
Free every hour.
